pages.title: Authority
pages.text: Every command under $(thing)/mystcraft$() requires permission level 2. Most controls act on the Mystcraft Age beneath the steward's feet. $(thing)create_age$(), $(thing)tp$(), and $(thing)sacrifice$() are the exceptions that name or create another realm.

pages.title: Creating and Traveling
pages.text: $(li)/mystcraft create_age creates a randomly written Age.$(li)/mystcraft tp <dimension> sends the executing player to that world's surface.$(li)/mystcraft sacrifice <dimension> permanently sacrifices the named Mystcraft Age without requiring held books.

pages.title: Temporary Time
pages.text: $(li)/mystcraft time set <day|noon|night|midnight|ticks> freezes the visible sky at that time until restart or resume.$(li)/mystcraft time resume clears that temporary override and returns to the Age's authored fixed or moving time.

pages.title: Permanent Time
pages.text: $(li)/mystcraft time permanent set <day|noon|night|midnight|ticks> rewrites the Age's saved time law.$()$(br2)If the Age was already fixed, it remains fixed at the new time. Otherwise its moving clock is set to that value and continues.

pages.title: Weather
pages.text: $(li)/mystcraft weather clear gives temporary clear weather.$(li)/mystcraft weather resume removes the temporary clearing.$(li)/mystcraft weather <normal|rain|thunder> rewrites the saved weather law.$(li)/mystcraft weather permanent <clear|normal|rain|thunder> provides the same persistent choices, including no weather.

pages.title: Serene Seasons
pages.text: When optional Serene Seasons is installed, each Age begins in a random sub-season and follows that Age's own time scale. A stopped clock also stops its seasons.$(br2)$(li)/mystcraft season reports the current state.$(li)/mystcraft season set <season> changes it.$(li)/mystcraft season <enable|disable> controls progression.

pages.title: Instability and Curses
pages.text: $(li)/mystcraft instability toggle suspends or restores tier symptoms without changing the score.$(li)/mystcraft curse list reports removable curses.$(li)/mystcraft curse cleanse removes the strongest curse for free and applies its normal instability relief.

pages.title: Effects and Gravity
pages.text: $(li)/mystcraft age_effect toggle silences or restores the written status effect.$(li)/mystcraft gravity get reports the current scale.$(li)/mystcraft gravity set <0.05..2.0> permanently sets gravity. These controls are independent of the instability-effects toggle.

pages.title: Balance Configuration
pages.text: With Mod Menu and Cloth Config installed, open Mystcraft Reforged's configuration to tune instability, world features, page loot, cave lighting, and page pools. See $(l:mystcraft-reforged:mechanics/balance_configuration)Balance Configuration$() for every setting and blacklist format.
